name_full: Modified Checklist for Autism in Toddlers, Revised with Follow-Up

metadata.description: Two-stage parent-report screening tool for autism risk in toddlers.
metadata.intended_use: Early screening and follow-up referral for toddlers approximately 16-30 months old.
metadata.name_origin: Modified Checklist for Autism in Toddlers, Revised with Follow-Up, abbreviated M-CHAT-R/F.
metadata.development_history: Revised the original M-CHAT and added a structured follow-up interview to reduce false-positive screens.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Early parent-observed social-communication and behavior indicators can support timely developmental evaluation.
metadata.interpretation_notes: A positive screen indicates need for follow-up or developmental evaluation, not autism diagnosis; use the official German form and process.
search_aliases: Modified Checklist for Autism in Toddlers
